description: This Java class, DefaultCachesConfig, is the default implementation of cache configuration for the Gateway service, handling cache settings for public keys. It provides methods to create instances based on external Config data and overrides typical Object methods.

classes.name: DefaultCachesConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing cache configuration settings for the Gateway service, specifically for public key caching.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultCachesConfig from a given Config object, initializing cache settings.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Configuration object containing cache settings at the path 'cache'.

methods.name: getPublicKeysConfig
methods.description: Returns the CacheConfig instance for public keys.
